zh: iOS 自动化流水线支持 App Store 与 Development 双模自动签名导出，确保 IPA 稳定产出与发布。
解决无头 CI 环境与真实 Chrome 在快速跳转场景下的 DOM 判定竞态，测试套件稳定性进一步提升。
新增微信本地库只读查询智能体技能，支持离线会话历史检索与安全消息查看。
en: Support dual-mode automatic iOS signing with App Store Connect and development fallback for reliable IPA exports.
Eliminate CDP DOM timing races during rapid page redirects to ensure rock-solid headless CI test runs.
Add read-only WeChat local vault agent skill for offline chat history inspection and secure message search.
